# Blindsight

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Vision and Senses](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Blindsight)*

If you have Blindsight, you can see within a specific range without relying on physical sight. Within that range, you can see anything that isn't behind [Total Cover](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/basic-rules/combat#Cover) even if you have the [Blinded](../Conditions/Blinded.md) condition or are in [Darkness](Darkness.md). Moreover, in that range, you can see something that has the [Invisible](../Conditions/Invisible.md) condition.
